text:
Mira (CEO): Morning team — quick weekly sync. Two high-priority asks this week: 1) Dedicated v2 rollout next Wed — goal: 99th pct latency <120ms for 512-token profiles. 2) Cost target: reduce per-token unit cost by ~15% by end of quarter (engineering + finance plan). Also: legal signed new SOC2 addendum for Private deployments, and we have the RCA draft for Friday's KV cache degradation in #postmortems. Please read and act on follow-ups.
Jonah (VP Product): Thanks — can you confirm the customer-facing fallback policy for Dedicated v2? Need wording for the support playbook and the customer note.
Priya (Head of Eng): Autoscale threshold PR merged to staging this morning. Verified continuous-batching configs and circuit-breaker default. Will run canary for 2 hours.
Sam (Finance): Good to hear on SOC2. Finance supports the cost targets; I'll publish updated unit economics and sensitivity table by Tuesday EOD.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: dedicated-rollout-v2 — canary id: crn-9882 — started at 1763458900
Priya (Head of Eng): Canary metrics are green so far: p95 and p99 within target, error rate <0.02%. Will flag if any regressions show up in the next 2 hours.
Jonah (VP Product): Perfect. I'll draft the short customer note (fallback behavior and expected timeline) and run it by Mira before sending.
Mira (CEO): Confirming fallback: route to hosted-compatible quantized variant with circuit-breaker engaged at 75% capacity; automatic retry with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts. @Priya please ensure the console shows explicit fallback state and telemetry.
Priya (Head of Eng): Will add a per-route banner and telemetry tag this afternoon.
Mira (CEO): Quick ask before I close — everyone drop a single metric you own by EOD Monday (one-liner). I'll consolidate and send updated priorities Tue morning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
